items.prompt: A program builds with all selected warnings enabled and no diagnostics. What follows?

options.text: All possible warnings were enabled by -Wall
options.why: The name does not mean every diagnostic.

options.text: The financial units and source identity are certified
options.why: The compiler cannot infer the full business contract.

options.text: Runtime tests and source review can be discarded
options.why: Both cover questions the build does not settle.

options.text: This source passed this configured build
options.why: Runtime safety and domain correctness remain separate.

items.explanation: Compiler/version/flags/source scope matter, and a successful build is not full qualification.
